steps.headline: Signed-in Account as labelled cards — keep?
steps.changed: Your profile: one card with your picture, name and @handle, Edit account on the right; below it "Signs in with GitHub" with Sign out beside it. Your data: one line saying what the download is, with Download my data beside it. Connections: the Connected services row now has its own label. (Blocked users, when you have any, get their own labelled card with one row per person.)
steps.notice: The three big full-width buttons become small outlined ones next to what they act on, so the popup is shorter. The buttons keep their exact words.

steps.headline: Edit account as cards — keep?
steps.changed: Display name and Handle sit in one Your profile card, with Done as a full-width button at its foot (it used to float at the top right beside a second "Edit account" label). Delete account sits in its own card under Danger zone.
steps.notice: Saving still happens with each field's own Save button; Done only returns to the view above.

steps.path: Claude Code session → click the model chip
steps.headline: Model menu: Effort and Fast mode as plain headings — keep?
steps.changed: Back to Effort as a bare heading over the segmented bar, with no explanation line. Fast mode matches it: the same plain heading with its short note and switch, with no lightning bolt and no card.
steps.notice: Before shows the card version you turned down, so you can compare the two.
